line: Beep boop. Hello there, strange being. My name is R.O.V.E.R., and I am here to assist you. What is your name?

Hugh Mann. A respectable name. Well, Hugh Mann, you are in a pickle. You have crash-landed on Mars. But don't fear! Our colonies on Earth have the resources to repair your vessel and send you home. Although... we do have a shortage with the Zenos running about.
*nervous laugh* Apologies, Hugh Mann. Perhaps this will be more difficult than I thought. Let's not waste time, then!
Beep boop. I can take you anywhere. Choose a destination.
Hugh Mann.
Halt, Earthling!  Dr Oxy Genn, Grand Master of Vastitas and licensed rock appraiser. Mostly licensed, just don't ask where I get them from.
You dig up ore, I give you Tintinas. Ice, iron, silica, sulfur, basalt... the rarer the rock, the shinier the coin. And Dr Oxy Genn loves coins.
Back again, Earthling? Dr Oxy Genn smells ore in those pockets. Let's deal.
Anything else, Earthling? Dr Oxy Genn's time is valuable. Dr Oxy Genn's time costs 2 Tintinas a minute.
The finest currency on Mars! Little gold T-Bits. Spend them with DJ-CMoney on drills, blasters and that sulfur filter you'll be needing.
Ice sits right here in Vastitas. Iron and silica hide in Alba Mons and Tempe Terra. Sulfur and basalt? Olympus Mons... but that's Zeno country. Bring a blaster. And a spare face.
Watch closely. *waves staff* ...There. I have made your doubt disappear. Dr Oxy Genn accepts tips.
Bring Dr Oxy Genn more rocks! Big ones! Shiny ones!
Aye, ahoy, me matie. Captain McMars reportin' for duty. Me and me crew of two specialize in ship systems and upgrades along with my trusty cyborg parrot, Mr. Squawkers
Bring the required raw goodies, and we can fix the Comm Array, Life Support, Fusion Power, and Propulsion of your fine ship. It's always good business with a space pirate, me matie!
Arg, look who it is, Mr. Squawkers. Back again, space cowboy? We get those ship systems online, arg.
Any other ship questions, pilot?
The Comm Array lets Earth hear you. Life Support keeps you breathing. Fusion Power supplies energy. Propulsion gets you off Mars. Restore all four to go home.
Ship systems depend on one another. Restore them in order: Comm Array, Life Support, Fusion Power, then Propulsion.
Bring the materials and we will get you home.
Yo, yo, yo! DJ-CMoney in the dome! Only bot on Mars still spinnin' vinyl and slingin' gear.
Drills, blasters, and the Sulfur Filter. You bring the Tintinas, I bring the heat. Cash only, space cowboy.
My favorite customer is back! What we copping today?
What else you need to know? Ask away, I got all day. Literally. Mars days are long.
Olympus Mons air is full of sulfur. Buy my Sulfur Filter before heading up there. Once purchased, it permanently unlocks the route and protects you while mining.
T1 is a start, T2 hits harder, and T3 is the Zeno melter. Equip with [2], then fire with SPACE or click.
Stay fresh out there. Peace!
